tagShapeMismatches.english: If any wyrmspeakers are killed or captured in your campaign—including {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}, who the characters might have defeated in {@i Hoard of the Dragon Queen}—Severin appoints new followers to his inner council.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果在你的戰役中有任何龍語者被殺或被俘——包括玩家可能在{@i 龍後的寶山}中擊敗的{@creature 瑞茲米爾|HotDQ}——賽維林會任命新的追隨者加入他的核心議會。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Kobolds move freely through the caverns, going about their business. Characters have a chance to randomly encounter these wandering kobolds. Roll a {@dice d6} every time characters enter or re-enter {@area areas 3|0b1|x} to {@area 10|0c8|x}. On a roll of 1, monsters are present. Roll on the table to determine what they meet. These randomly encountered monsters are added to any creatures mentioned in the area description. Be sure to make this roll before characters enter the area, because both groups have a chance to gain surprise.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 狗頭人在洞穴中自由穿行，忙於他們的事情。角色有機會隨機遇到這些遊蕩的狗頭人。每次角色進入或重新進入{@area 區域3|0b1|x}到{@area 10|0c8|x}時，擲一個{@dice d6}。如果是1點，怪物就會出現。根據表格擲骰以確定他們遇到了什麼。這些隨機遇到的怪物將被新增到區域描述中提到的任何生物中。確保在角色進入區域之前進行這次擲骰，因為兩組都有獲得突襲的機會。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Bog Luck has this room to himself, so it's more spacious and comfortable than the others. He's seldom here except when sleeping, and he keeps the door locked. A successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} can open it. Despite his crude manner, Bog Luck is a somewhat educated man, as evidenced by the books of philosophy and natural history on his reading shelf.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 博格·勒克這個房間是他獨自擁有的，所以比其他房間更寬敞舒適。他除了睡覺幾乎不在這裡，而且他時常鎖著門。用 {@item 盜賊工具|PHB} 進行一次成功的 {@dc 10}敏捷檢定可以開啟它。儘管博格·勒克舉止粗魯，但他是個有些學識的人，這一點從他書架上擺放的哲學和自然史書籍可以看出。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The second level of the northwest tower is in bad shape. There are large holes where the floorboards have completely rotted away or fallen into the muck below, and the floorboards that remain are unlikely to support a human's weight. The beams are still strong, but they are slick with fungus and mold. A successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check is needed to cross the level on a beam without slipping and falling into the awfulness of {@area area 1E|148|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 西北塔樓的第二層狀況很差。地板已經完全腐爛或掉落到下面的泥漿中，留下了大洞，而剩餘的地板也不大可能承受一個人的重量。梁木仍然結實，但上面覆蓋著滑膩的真菌和黴菌。要安全地穿過這一層而不滑倒並掉入{@area 區域1E|148|x}的糟糕境地，需要進行一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill 特技}）檢定。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character who inspects the contents of the observatory recognizes the {@i farseer of Illusk} with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. After its true nature is ascertained, using it to view a distant location requires a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the Intelligence check fails, the desired location can't be found. If the Dexterity check fails, the image is too distorted to convey any information. If the Dexterity check result is 5 or less, a key part of the {@i farseer} breaks off, rendering the item inoperable.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個角色在成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定時，能夠識別出觀象臺內的 {@i 伊盧斯克的預言者}。在確定其真實性質後，使用它來觀察遠處的區域需要成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定和一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill 巧手}）檢定。如果智力檢定失敗，無法找到期望的位置。如果敏捷檢定失敗，影象過於扭曲，無法傳達任何資訊。如果敏捷檢定結果為5或更低，{@i 先知}的關鍵部分會斷裂，使該物品無法使用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the party lingers outside the lodge or explores the woods nearby, it finds company. Those with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 12 or higher are not {@status surprised} by the rush of a group of two {@creature Troll||trolls} and three {@creature Ambush Drake|HotDQ|ambush drakes} (see {@adventure appendix D|HotDQ|12} for Statistics) that has been wandering the area. The combat alerts Talis that she has company. The trolls serve as the lodge's bouncers, and anyone who is not expected is eaten.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果隊伍在小屋外逗留或探索附近的樹林，就會發現有伴。那些被動感知（{@skill 察覺}）得分為12或更高的人不會被兩群{@creature 巨魔||巨魔}和三隻{@creature 伏擊龍獸|HotDQ|伏擊龍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|HotDQ|12}的具體數值）的突襲所{@status 突襲}。這些生物一直在該地區徘徊。戰鬥提醒塔利斯她有伴了。巨魔充當小屋的保鏢，任何不受歡迎的人都會被吃掉。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The door is always locked and {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ} holds the key. A {@spell knock} spell is the easiest way to get in, but a character can also unlock the door with a {@dc 25} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. Alternatively, knocking and spinning a good yarn might work; cultists and servants come and go at all hours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這扇門總是鎖著的，而{@creature 瑞茲米爾|HotDQ}持有鑰匙。使用{@spell 敲擊術}法術是最簡單的進入方式，但角色也可以使用{@item 盜賊工具|PHB}進行一次{@dc 25}的敏捷檢定來解鎖這扇門。另外，敲門並編造一個好故事可能也有效；邪教徒和僕人隨時進出。

numericDifferences.localized: 邪教反擊（第一部分）
邪教反擊（第二部分）
邪教反擊（第三部分）
第四階段

numericDifferences.english: If characters don't use cover and stealth to avoid encounters, roll a {@dice d8} for every 100 feet they move in town. If the roll is 4 or lower, they didn't attract attention with that move. If the roll is 5 or higher, they run into something; roll a {@dice d8} again and check the Chapter 1 Encounters table to see what the characters meet.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色不使用掩體和潛行來避免遭遇，他們在城鎮中每移動100尺就擲一個{@dice d8}。如果擲出的結果是4或更低，他們那次移動沒有引起注意。如果擲出的結果是5或更高，他們就會遇到某些東西；再擲一個{@dice d8}，並檢查第一章遭遇表，看看角色們遇到了什麼。

numericDifferences.english: When characters return to the camp area, they find it mostly abandoned. (If they stayed, they witnessed the rapid packing up and abandonment of the camp.) The stinking huts of the kobolds (those on level 1) have been burned, but the level 2 huts and both guard towers remain. Anyone can determine from tracks that the cultists trekked away in small groups in all directions. A successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check reveals that most of the camp's wagons and pack animals moved in a train toward the west.
numericDifferences.localized: 當角色們返回營地時，發現那裡大部分已被遺棄。（如果他們留了下來，他們會目睹營地迅速收拾並遺棄的過程。）狗頭人的惡臭小屋（位於第一層的那些）已被燒燬，但第二層的小屋和兩座守衛塔仍然存在。任何人都可以根據足跡判斷，邪教徒們分成小組向四面八方撤離。一次成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定顯示，營地的大多數馬車和馱獸都向西方向排成一行移動。

numericDifferences.english: If characters ask around Waterdeep's northern gate about anyone matching {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ}'s description, they hear rumors of a half-dragon being sighted in the area at least a tenday ago. Everyone remembers the incident; chromatic half-dragons are almost never seen, and they tend to cause alarm when they are. If the rumor is true, then the half-dragon was traveling with a strong escort of mounted guards, headed north. The rumor is true, of course, but it can't be confirmed 100 percent.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色在深水城北門附近打聽是否有人見過符合{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ|瑞茲米爾}描述的人物，會聽到傳聞：至少十天前，有人在附近見過一名半龍。所有人都記得這件事；彩色半龍幾乎從不現身，一旦出現往往就會引起恐慌。若傳聞屬實，那名半龍是在一支強大的騎兵護衛隊保護下往北行進。當然，傳聞確實屬實，只是無法百分之百證實。
第一天
第一天晚上
第二天

numericDifferences.english: A half-dozen dugout canoes are pulled up onto land here. Three to five paddles lie in the bottom of each. Five of them are in good condition; the sixth has a rotten bottom, and the lizardfolk never use it. If characters grab canoes in a hurry, there is a 1-in-6 chance they get the rotten one. It starts leaking as soon as it's put in water, and it sinks after fifteen minutes.
numericDifferences.localized: 這裡拉上了半打的獨木舟。每艘舟底部有三到五支槳。其中五艘狀況良好；第六艘底部腐爛，蜥蜴人從不使用它。如果角色匆忙中拿了獨木舟，有六分之一的機率他們會拿到腐爛的那艘。它一放入水中就開始漏水，並且在十五分鐘後沉沒。

numericDifferences.english: Each of these longhouses could house twenty-five lizardfolk comfortably, and more with some crowding. When {@creature Rezmir|HotDQ} first negotiated with the lizardfolk, they intended to move the entire village here, and built accordingly. As more bullywugs also flocked to the castle and the real situation became apparent, the warriors instructed their families to stay behind. Thus, they have far more longhouse space at the castle than they need. Characters observing the area from hiding and judging solely from the longhouses would estimate conservatively that over a hundred lizardfolk live at the castle. They won't count anywhere near that many lizardfolk in the clearing. Snapjaw can explain the discrepancy, if he's around.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些長屋每座都能舒適地容納25個蜥蜴人，如果擁擠一些，甚至可以容納更多。當{@creature Rezmir|HotDQ|瑞茲米爾}首次與蜥蜴人協商時，他們打算將整個村莊遷移到這裡，並據此建造。隨著更多的啵靈蛙也湧向城堡，實際情況變得明朗，戰士們指示他們的家人留在後面。因此，他們在城堡擁有的長屋空間遠遠超出了他們的需求。如果角色從藏身處觀察該區域，僅憑長屋來判斷，他們會保守估計城堡裡有超過一百個蜥蜴人居住。他們在空地上不會數到那麼多蜥蜴人。如果咬顎在附近，他可以解釋這種差異。
地圖 6.2: 納裡塔城堡—第二層
地圖 6.3: 納裡塔城堡 - 第三層

numericDifferences.english: Two matched onyx carvings of black dragons flank the top of the staircase. A serious collector would pay up to 3,000 gp for the pair. They are three feet tall and weigh 400 pounds apiece.
numericDifferences.localized: 樓梯頂部兩側各有一尊匹配的黑龍玉雕。一位嚴肅的收藏家可能會為這對玉雕支付高達3000金幣。它們每個高3尺，重400磅。

numericDifferences.english: Searching characters do see the glint of gems beneath the water at the east end of the chamber. Fishing through that area turns up a handful of fancy and semiprecious stones worth 1,800 gp (2 × 50 gp, 5 × 100 gp, 200 gp, 400 gp, 600 gp). The gems came from a less-than-devoted cultist who throws a fistful of coins and other treasure items into area 2 every time he gets the chance. His plan is to come back to the castle after the cult leaves and collect his "retirement fund." Unknown to him, the ooze living in area 2 scoops up the items when it passes through its lair. All the items except the gems dissolve in the ooze's body. The stones fascinate the creature's tiny brain, so it "spits out" the gems in the corner and collects them. The ooze won't bother those who enter, look around, and leave. It fights back if attacked, and it attacks (probably with surprise) anyone who takes gems.
numericDifferences.localized: 搜尋的角色確實能在房間東端的水下看到寶石的閃光。在那個區域搜尋會找到一小把價值1800金幣的奇特和半寶石（2顆每顆50金幣，5顆每顆100金幣，1顆200金幣，1顆400金幣，1顆600金幣）。這些寶石來自一個不太虔誠的邪教徒，他每次有機會就會把一把硬幣和其他寶藏物品扔進2號區域。他計劃在邪教離開後回到城堡並收集他的"退休基金"。他不知道的是，居住在2號區域的軟泥怪在經過它的巢穴時會撈起這些物品。除了寶石以外，所有物品都在軟泥怪體內溶解。這些石頭吸引了這個生物微小的大腦，所以它"吐出"寶石並收集它們。軟泥怪不會打擾那些進入、四處看看然後離開的人。如果被攻擊，它會反擊，並且如果有人拿走寶石，它會（很可能是突襲）攻擊任何人。

numericDifferences.english: When characters enter, a {@creature giant frog} sits still on the island and watches them. Most characters can't see that far from the entrance with torches or lanterns. If the characters stick to the shore between the east and north entrances, the frog doesn't react. If someone enters the water or walks out onto the promontory, the frog croaks loudly and splashes into the water. Characters hear more croaking and at least a dozen splashes from area 7. If they are still in area 6 or area 7 after 2 rounds, they are attacked by twelve {@creature Giant Frog||giant frogs}. The frogs focus their attacks on small characters they can swallow.
numericDifferences.localized: 當角色進入時，一隻{@creature giant frog||巨蛙}靜止地坐在島上觀察他們。大多數角色在入口處使用火把或燈籠無法看得那麼遠。如果角色堅持沿著東邊和北邊入口之間的岸邊行走，青蛙不會有反應。如果有人進入水中或走到海岬上，青蛙會大聲叫喚並跳入水中。角色聽到更多的叫聲，至少有十二聲濺水聲來自區域7。如果他們在兩輪後仍然在區域6或區域7，他們將被十二隻{@creature Giant Frog||巨蛙}攻擊。這些青蛙集中攻擊它們可以吞下的小型角色。

numericDifferences.english: The double doors to the stables are 20 feet tall and wide, making it easy for the wyverns (see below) to get in and out.
numericDifferences.localized: 馬廄的雙扇門高達20尺，寬也是20尺，這使得飛龍（見下文）可以輕鬆進出。

numericDifferences.english: The treasure hoard is frozen in ice, and it requires either several fire spells or a long wait with bonfires to melt the ice. The hoard includes 500,000 cp, 100,000 sp, and 5,000 gp, a frozen chest containing 800 pp and 21 small blue sapphires worth 300 gp each, a frozen {@item potion of gaseous form}, a {@item +1 longsword}, a {@item +1 longbow}, {@item +1 leather armor}, and {@item bracers of defense}.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些財寶被凍結在冰中，需要使用多個火系法術或者長時間用篝火等待才能融化冰層。財寶包括500,000銅幣，100,000銀幣，和5,000金幣，一個凍結的箱子，內含800鉑金和21顆小藍寶石，每顆價值300金幣，一個凍結的{@item potion of gaseous form||氣化形體藥水}（氣態形態藥水），一把{@item +1 longsword||+1 長劍}（+1長劍），一把{@item +1 longbow||+1 長弓}（+1長弓），一件{@item +1 leather armor||+1 皮甲}（+1皮甲），以及{@item bracers of defense||防禦護腕}（防禦護腕）。
第二級 & 第四級
第二級：龍翼
第三級：龍牙

reviewedNumericEquivalences.reason: 100 percent = 百分之百; at least a tenday is preserved as 至少十天.
